recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-15692; future procedure-directedBy changes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack with Orders and Observations and Patient Care review if the ServiceRequest or Procedure extension scope changes.
issue_request: FHIR-15692 asked for a way on ServiceRequest to indicate whether an LTSS service was self-directed. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution chose to add ServiceRequest context to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/procedure-directedBy and clarify that the directed actor is distinct from the requester, rather than adding a new core ServiceRequest element.
initial_application: Historical core commit b1dc88787a explicitly included GF#15692 and changed source/procedure/procedure-extensions-spreadsheet.xml so the directedBy extension context changed from Procedure to Procedure;ServiceRequest. The pre-removal core extension definition later contained Procedure and ServiceRequest contexts, the approved CodeableConcept/Reference value choices, and the clarified requester-distinct wording.
additional_context: FHIR-15691 created the paired Procedure directedBy extension and is already represented on the combined branch by 8016eb3812d7edc918852a6e72517bfec364fae8. FHIR-17543 later clarified the directedBy wording and is already represented by a19a0ac05f7e586e1b7bb3d734db41b66a450b37. Current core source keeps ServiceRequest active/approved and retains the procedure-directedBy OID, but R5 source history removed the extension definition from core; the FHIR Extension Pack now contains the authoritative definition with ServiceRequest context and clarified text. Later FHIR-23049 context supports that the self-directed-service data remains an extension unless O&O promotes it to a core element.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source files were changed. The current core checkout no longer owns the authoritative procedure-directedBy definition, and the Extension Pack source already contains the requested ServiceRequest context and wording, so a core source edit would be out of build scope.
